text.short: Carson City, on a street called Basque Way. Pete and Martha Coscarart's counter, and the home of Pete's chorizo.
text.today: Kitchen six to half past two, Tuesday to Saturday; the chorizo shop stays open to four.
text.history: Pete's Basque chorizo started in Battle Mountain in 1984 and came south with them.
text.note: Two businesses in one door: a café you sit down in, and a sausage counter you leave with a bag from.

seating.note: A café room and a shop counter. Breakfast and lunch only.

picon.note: It closes before a Picon hour.
